title: Purple Crystal Warrior Poses
description: Four distinct poses of a muscular dark-skinned female warrior with short white hair, wearing a revealing purple crystal armor set with matching gauntlets and greaves. She is surrounded by glowing purple energy shards and bright magical effects against a solid black background.
prompt: A powerful dark-skinned female warrior with short white hair and muscular build wearing ornate purple crystal shard armor, gauntlets and leg guards. She appears in four different dynamic poses: exploding with purple energy shards, running forward casting magic, standing powerfully with bright purple light burst from her hands, and a neutral standing pose. Glowing purple crystals and energy fragments floating around her, dramatic lighting, solid black background, high detail digital fantasy art.
